Scalemail
Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail stacks from scoring takedowns against certain enemies. Large monsters and large minions grant a stack, while enemy champions and epic monsters grant more. Scalemail: For each stack, Shyvana gains bonus armor and bonus magic resist.
Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail stacks from scoring takedowns against certain enemies. Large monsters and large minions grant 1 stack, while enemy champions and epic monsters grant 3.
Scalemail: For each stack, Shyvana gains 0.3 bonus armor and 0.3 bonus magic resistance.

COOLDOWN:

CAST TIME:

Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown, and deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Active: Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within a few seconds to trigger an additional exclusive effect. Emberstrike can be recast shortly after the attack.
First Cast: Shyvana's slashes her claws, blasting a cone that deals physical damage to enemies hit. Second Cast: Shyvana slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies. Dragon Form Bonus — Third Cast: Shyvana bites ferociously, dealing true damage.
Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds, and deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health. Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.
Active: Emberstrike can be cast twice in Human Form and thrice in Dragon Form. Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and trigger an additional exclusive effect. After 1.5 seconds of using an Emberstrike attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and up to the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its cooldown. Shyvana gains 50 bonus range on all of her basic attacks while Emberstrike is active. The attacks deal 10 bonus physical damage against monsters.
First Cast: Shyvana slashes her claws, blasting a cone in the target's direction that deals modified physical damage to enemies hit. The damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers.
Area Physical Damage:10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+ 110% AD) (+ 30% AP)
Second Cast: Shyvana slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
Dragon Form Bonus — Third Cast: Shyvana takes a bite out of the target, dealing modified true damage. This damage cannot critically strike.
True Damage:15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 (+ 165% AD) (+ 45% AP)
All casts reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.

Tips & Tricks
Because of how ultimate haste interacts with Shyvana's fury generation, it has a bigger effect than haste has on abilities with a regular cooldown.
Dragon's Descent essentially has a cooldown of 200 / 133.333 / 100 seconds, reduced by 0.625 / 0.4167 / 0.3125 for each damaging basic attack and ability hit, increased to 2.5 / 1.67 / 1.25 against champions.
It also essentially lasts for 15 seconds, increased by 0.140625 for each basic attack and ability hit, increased to 0.5625 against champions.
Normally, with 100 haste, the only effect would be the cooldown getting reduced by 50% to 100 / 66.667 / 50, but because 100 ultimate haste grants Shyvana an extra 100% bonus fury generation from all sources, this also increases how much the "cooldown" is reduced by basic attacks and abilities to 1.25 / 0.8333 / 0.625 for non-champions and 5 / 3.33 / 2.5 for champions.
This is the opposite effect to abilities with cooldown reductions that scale with haste (e.g. Master Yi's Alpha Strike), which instead lower the reduction amount with haste. This happens because ultimate haste increases fury generation from all sources instead of only increasing her passive fury generation.
Additionally, this also affects the duration increase per basic attack or ability the same way, amounting to an extra 0.28125 against non-champions and 1.125 against champions.

Tips & Tricks
Because of how ultimate haste interacts with Shyvana's fury generation, it has a bigger effect than haste has on abilities with a regular cooldown.
Dragon's Descent essentially has a cooldown of 200 / 133.333 / 100 seconds, reduced by 0.625 / 0.4167 / 0.3125 for each damaging basic attack and ability hit, increased to 2.5 / 1.67 / 1.25 against champions.
It also essentially lasts for 15 seconds, increased by 0.140625 for each basic attack and ability hit, increased to 0.5625 against champions.
Normally, with 100 haste, the only effect would be the cooldown getting reduced by 50% to 100 / 66.667 / 50, but because 100 ultimate haste grants Shyvana an extra 100% bonus fury generation from all sources, this also increases how much the "cooldown" is reduced by basic attacks and abilities to 1.25 / 0.8333 / 0.625 for non-champions and 5 / 3.33 / 2.5 for champions.
This is the opposite effect to abilities with cooldown reductions that scale with haste (e.g. Master Yi's Alpha Strike), which instead lower the reduction amount with haste. This happens because ultimate haste increases fury generation from all sources instead of only increasing her passive fury generation.
Additionally, this also affects the duration increase per basic attack or ability the same way, amounting to an extra 0.28125 against non-champions and 1.125 against champions.
